authority_rule: Each reaction declares balanced inputs, outputs, catalysts, losses, energy conditions, machine authority, provenance transform, and runtime evidence.
review_scope: The rejected contracts below cover only the ten removed direct elemental-metal outputs. Every other authored transformation remains pending reaction-level balance and behavioral review; presence in source is not approval.

rejected_recipe_families.source_specificity_finding: Rejected: each periodic group reused one generic deposit selector for every member, so the input composition did not justify the selected element; the molecule subset likewise lacked accepted fixed-packet source contracts.
rejected_recipe_families.magic_provenance_finding: Rejected: LP and slate costs did not declare an identity-changing provenance transform or material-specific residue, including for radioactive species.
rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: probabilistic Create yields, multi-item Blood outputs, and item-to-gas volume conversion had no shared fixed-mass basis or complete residue accounting.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: Create and Blood Magic directly formed finished elemental metals reserved to TConstruct metallurgy.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: opaque one-item element, dust, and plate packets were treated as equal without an accepted common mass basis.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: Create milling and compacting directly formed or reclaimed finished elemental material reserved to TConstruct metallurgy and remelting.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: This disposition does not approve formula, compound-recovery, sink, or molecule-use generators.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: two opaque compound items were mapped to one opaque elemental item without a common fixed-mass basis or composition-derived stoichiometry.
rejected_recipe_families.residue_finding: Rejected: pressure seals were consumed while every non-target atom in the oxide, chloride, nitrate, sulfate, sulfide, carbonate, hydroxide, or phosphate input disappeared without a named residue.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Rejected: PNCR directly formed finished elemental material reserved to TConstruct metallurgy and remelting.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: This disposition does not approve formula creation, sinks, molecule-use generators, or the retained cross-script identity list.
